action.text: BUG: compiler/unary.py visit_UnaryOp returns node.operand for BOTH UAdd and USub, dropping negation for ALL operands. Contract (README): only exact built-in int/float (non-bool) numeric literals may fold - UAdd->operand (required), USub->Constant(-value) (may); ALL other operands (names, calls, user-defined unary ops, bool, and UInvert) must keep the UnaryOp node (preserve operator dispatch, values, types, exceptions, negative zero). FIX: gate both UAdd and USub on isinstance(operand,ast.Constant) and isinstance(operand.value,(int,float)) and not bool; UAdd returns operand, USub returns ast.Constant(-operand.value); else return node. REPORT reports/incident.json (structure per README: {"builds":[{"capture","changed_functions","first_change"}]}): BUILD-A capture=OBS-0002 (sel=[_normal_dist_inv_cdf]) changed_functions=[_normal_dist_inv_cdf], first_change function=_normal_dist_inv_cdf before=-log(r) after=log(r). BUILD-B capture=OBS-0003 (sel=both) changed_functions=[_normal_dist_inv_cdf, weibullvariate] (source order), first_change function=_normal_dist_inv_cdf before=-log(r) after=log(r). Verified diffs: stmt r=sqrt(-log(r)) is the first changed node in both (UnaryOp->Call); BUILD-A stmt x=-x -> x=x (2nd); BUILD-B additionally weibullvariate return alpha*-_log(u)**(1/beta) -> alpha*_log(u)**(1/beta) (that USub dropped) - this build returns complex because log(u)<0 raised to fractional power; BUILD-A weibullvariate is UNCHANGED (USub kept). Reference OBS-0001: _normal_dist_inv_cdf returns -2.3263478740408408 (float), weibullvariate returns 1.6651092223153954 (real float). CAPTURED behavior (historical buggy builds) is DISTINCT from the current repaired candidate; public check validates BOTH the optimizer contract on the current candidate AND the historical report. Next steps: read incident.json (need content+sha) -> patch unary.py -> patch incident.json -> check public -> submit.
